title: Hack Back Online Articles
coreMove: Turn reading into a bounded act by choosing the article, capture path, and stopping point before links choose for you.
sourcePressure: The chapter narrows browser drift to article pages where links, sidebars, and recommendations turn bounded reading into wandering.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would become anti-reading advice instead of protecting intentional reading from page-level prompts.

hook: Hack Back Online Articles as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: policy analyst reading a housing ordinance explainer
exampleSpecs.audience: analyst who needs one clause answer
exampleSpecs.stakes: sidebars can eat the research block without answering the question
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes the clause question on a sticky note and sends useful links to a later reading queue
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A zoning clause printout sits beside a handwritten question sticky.

exampleSpecs.domain: birding guide checking an article on migration timing
exampleSpecs.audience: guide who follows every species link
exampleSpecs.stakes: tomorrow's tour plan needs one timing decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he captures two relevant paragraphs to the tour folder and closes the tab before clicking related species
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A migration chart rests beside a tour folder tab.

exampleSpecs.domain: consumer-rights attorney reading a repair-rights update
exampleSpecs.stakes: client advice depends on the statute change, not the argument below
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she states the client question aloud, saves the statute excerpt, and skips comments
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A statute excerpt is highlighted beside a muted comments pane.

exampleSpecs.domain: chef researching a fermentation safety article
exampleSpecs.stakes: recipe links can derail prep compliance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, he opens five recipes; after, he saves the temperature line and returns to the prep chart
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A fermentation temperature chart lies beneath a tablet stand.

exampleSpecs.domain: city cyclist reading a road-closure article
exampleSpecs.audience: commuter who only needs tomorrow's detour
exampleSpecs.stakes: the commute plan gets lost in local-news scrolling
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she screenshots the detour map and closes the article before opening opinion links
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A detour map glows above a clipped transit card.

exampleSpecs.domain: historical novelist checking a textile article
exampleSpecs.audience: writer who reads endlessly instead of drafting one scene
exampleSpecs.stakes: research becomes avoidance if the stopping point is missing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he copies one fabric detail into the scene note and returns to the draft paragraph
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A textile weave diagram sits beside a draft scene note.
